    Top paths of Π(A_M) for a path rooted at an end #

    characteristic-two-mesh-calculations.tex: for the line on 1, …, M, (V_d)_{ij} = 1 exactly when |i − j| ≤ d ≤ min(i + j − 2, 2M − i − j) and d ≡ i − j (mod 2), for 0 ≤ d ≤ M − 1; "V_{M−1} is reflection". With the lower bound eq:preprojective-lower-bound, every vertex of Π(A_M) has a nonzero path of degree M − 1 to its reflection. This is the form used for the even lines A_{r+1} retained in the odd quotients of even A.

    Here the line is the one-armed star (L 0 = M − 2), and the position of a vertex is its depth plus one.
